Opportunity Details

  • High volume, established hospital employed practice with a large referral base seeking a BE/BC Rheumatologist
  • Practice located in an expansive health campus with a large infusion center, lab and radiology services
  • Epic EMR
  • Supportive leadership and collegial medical staff
  • Competitive compensation, excellent benefits and relocation assistance
  • Family oriented community with affordable cost of living
  • Recreational activities galore

Health System Details

Located in Upstate South Carolina, AnMed is a 648 bed, award winning health system recognized for patient safety and clinical excellence and applauded as a regional healthcare leader.  AnMed's Medical Group is comprised of over 57 owned or managed physician practices with practices located in Anderson and Pickens Counties South Carolina as well as in Northeast Georgia.   

Community Details

Located along South Carolina’s National Heritage Corridor, the greater Anderson area is a fast-growing and diverse county of about 185,000 residents in the northwest area of South Carolina near beautiful Lake Hartwell and the foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains.  Lake front property is very affordable and property taxes are lower than neighboring counties.  The area is known for its top-rated public and private schools, a thriving downtown, attractive cost of living and cultural opportunities associated with Anderson and Clemson Universities.  Anderson has a moderate temperature year round with four distinct seasons.  The nearby mountains provide a show of incredible fall colors and the coast is close by as well. 

The exciting atmosphere of college and university life is just a short drive away.  Anderson University is located in the city, while Clemson University is 30 minutes away.  Other nearby institutions include Erskine College and Furman University.

About AnMed

Founded in 1908, AnMed is an independent, not-for-profit health system serving Upstate South Carolina and northeast Georgia. It is licensed for 648 beds and anchored by AnMed Medical Center, a 495-bed acute-care hospital that’s earned the prestigious Magnet designation from the American Nurses Credentialing Center since 2012. Also included are a heart and vascular center, a comprehensive cancer center, a maternity center, a behavioral health hospital, a rehabilitation hospital, and AnMed Integrated Therapy and AnMed Urgent Care locations. The AnMed Piedmont campus and its freestanding emergency department opened in 2025, and a new campus serving Clemson and Central is under construction and scheduled to open in 2027. Nearly 60 physician practices are also among service sites spread throughout the region. The system has 742 physicians on medical staff and more than 4,000 employees. Guided by core values of compassion, innovation, integrity, accountability and collaboration, AnMed was named one of the nation’s “Great Community Hospitals” by Becker’s Hospital Review. It’s also been named among the nation’s 165 top places to work in health care. It is one of three systems in the nation to earn the 2024 Carolyn Boone Lewis Equity of Care Award from the American Hospital Association. Learn more at AnMed.org.
